data.name: Rakhamah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Rahmah' which means 'Grace', 'Compassion' and 'Mercy'. This name is often given to girls to signify the best of these virtues.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the spirit of kindness, compassion, and mercy. It is a reminder to always be gracious and merciful towards others.
